verdicts.strongest_argument: Three independent grounds, and the size check alone is close to fatal. (1) Size: 26,343 shares at $18.75 is about $494,000 against a $1.545bn market cap - 0.032% of the company. That is the classic error this role is meant to catch: real, verifiable, and too small to move a stock whose median earnings reaction is 11.35% and whose 20-day realised vol is 89% annualised. (2) Publication: the Form 4s are public EDGAR filings accepted 2026-07-16 between 21:36:43Z and 21:40:34Z and indexed in the capture's own filings.json, and the hunter itself documents that the corpus published the specific numbers before the print - $18.75, 26,343 shares and the $21 offering price are quoted in docs/4690318854...txt at 2026-08-29T00:41:26Z and 2026-08-29T10:03:51Z and again in docs/72990000...txt at 2026-09-01T12:26:03Z. A six-week transmission lag is irrelevant when the transmission completed three sessions before the print and inside the admissible window. (3) The balance-sheet consequence the hunter says the market has not drawn - financing done, runway off the table - rests on 424B5 prospectuses from 2026-07-07 and 2026-07-08, and the admissible bars show that raise being priced with extreme violence: 07-06 close 29.73 -> 07-07 25.96 (12.6m shares) -> 07-08 22.54 (21.5m shares) -> 07-16 17.26, a 42% drawdown in eight sessions on two to three times normal volume. The market did not miss the raise; it repriced the equity around it. Finally the sign is contradicted by the admissible tape after the insider buy surfaced: 08-27 close 19.32 -> 08-28 17.76 -> 08-31 17.23 on 9,056,300 shares against a 7,574,705-share 20d average -> 09-01 17.08. The insider purchase became visible in the retail stream on 08-29 and the stock fell 11.6% over the following two sessions on above-average volume. A finding signed positive on a director's underwater buy has to account for the market selling into the disclosure. I stop at 85 rather than higher because no document in the admissible corpus explicitly frames 'cash runway is not a question at this print', so that specific framing is reachable rather than drawn out.

prior_publication.what_it_says: The open-market director purchase is a mandated public Form 4, on EDGAR the same evening it happened.
The captured public feed states the $18.75 price, the 26,343 share count and the $21 offering price four sessions before the print - the finding's own numbers, published pre-print.
Republishes the same insider-buy and offering-price detail on the last session before the print.
The July equity raise at $21 was completed via public prospectus supplements on 2026-07-07 and 2026-07-08.

verdicts.baseline_evidence: Admissible bars only (clean-view excludes the 2026-09-02 bar and snapshot 20260902T150734Z; this is a bmo print so the event-day close is the reaction). The July raise: 29.73 on 07-06 to 17.26 on 07-16, -42% on 9.4m-21.5m share days against a 7.57m average - the runway event is emphatically in the price. After the insider buy surfaced on 08-29: 19.32 -> 17.76 -> 17.23 (9.06m shares, above average) -> 17.08, i.e. the disclosure was met with selling, not a bid. Baseline itself is sound (fits_cadence, 8 events, 11.35% median), so the claim gets no help from a defective anchor.
verdicts.what_would_change_it: An insider purchase an order of magnitude larger relative to market cap, or a dated pre-print source showing consensus still modelled a dilutive raise inside the reported quarter that the July 424B5s had already removed.

interactions: The finding and its 'independence' corroboration (a reported 114,000-share after-hours block) sit in the same document, docs/72990000...txt, so they are one source, not two; the hunter concedes the block is retail-reported and unverifiable.
corpus_limits: Per clean-view/FCEL.json I excluded snapshot 20260902T150734Z and the 2026-09-02 bar, so I have no view of the event-day sweep or tape. FCEL's capture carries no news items or analyst previews, so I cannot check wire or sell-side treatment of either the Form 4 or the July raise; that silence is a capture artefact and is not scored as non-publication. No options chain, so no implied move to compare against.
